hook.from: Geography > Location, Terrain, Natural resources; Economy > Exports
hook.excerpt: Central Europe, bordering the Baltic Sea and the North Sea, between the Netherlands and Poland, south of Denmark || lowlands in north, uplands in center, Bavarian Alps in south || strategic location on North European Plain and along the entrance to the Baltic Sea; most major rivers in Germany -- the Rhine, Weser, Oder, Elbe -- flow northward; the Danube, which originates in the Black Forest, flows eastward || Resources: coal, lignite, natural gas, iron ore, copper, nickel, uranium, potash, salt, construction materials, timber, arable land || Exports: cars, vehicle parts/accessories, packaged medicine, plastic products, vaccines (2023)

physicalGeography.excerpt: lowlands in north, uplands in center, Bavarian Alps in south || Central Europe, bordering the Baltic Sea and the North Sea, between the Netherlands and Poland, south of Denmark

climate.excerpt: temperate and marine; cool, cloudy, wet winters and summers; occasional warm mountain (foehn) wind || flooding

economy.excerpt: leading export-driven, core EU and eurozone economy; key automotive, chemical, engineering, finance, and green energy industries; growth stalled by energy crisis and declining exports; tight labor market with falling working-age population; fiscal rebalancing with phaseout of energy price supports || Exports: cars, vehicle parts/accessories, packaged medicine, plastic products, vaccines (2023) || Industries: iron, steel, coal, cement, chemicals, machinery, vehicles, machine tools, electronics, automobiles, food and beverages, shipbuilding, textiles
